reason: I'd try the free dishes and the Sunday cook-ahead plan because that fits how I cook, but tom yum, pad see ew and massaman are all over YouTube for free. 99 baht isn't much money; I just don't see why I'd pay ahead for recipes that don't exist yet when I haven't even cooked the free ones.
objection: I can watch a free video for this. Paying now for a pack that comes later, for dishes I can already find free, feels like paying for something I don't need yet.
would_change_my_mind: If I cook the free dishes for a few Sundays and the step reminders and 'It didn't work' button actually fix my mistakes in a way a video can't, plus the pack includes more cook-ahead plans for the week, I'd pay the 99 baht.
